node.statement: Using the positive finite quantities already produced by (1.1)-(1.2), (1.3) makes C_N, C_R, C_L, and C_Upsilon' finite positive; since C_R>0, (2*C_R)^(-1)>0, and therefore (1.4) makes rho_Upsilon' a finite minimum of positive radii and hence positive. These derived scalars remain independent of all input data.
